name: smwgraphics-sicari
title: Sicari 2 - The Beach Girls
description:
The graphics for "The Beach Girls" from Sicari 2 - The Brink of Time. A sparkling, tropical beach with a sunset, best used for beaches, obviously. You have a palm tree to play around with, and special layer 1 water to go with the tileset.

There is also an optional HDMA + parallax for you.
